The dataset lists the date, teams, score, attendance, division, tier, and season of each match, as well as each season’s final standings.
questions: ewfmatches contains all matches that have been played and has one observation per match per season.
ewfappearances contains all appearances by a team and has one observation per team per match per season.
ewfstandings contains all end-of-the-season division tables and has one observation per team per season.
